h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shimoga

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Shimoga

c: Shimoga sits at the edge of the Malnad, where the Western Ghats bring some of Karnataka's heaviest monsoon rain. We supply outdoor gym equipment in Shimoga to municipal parks, schools, colleges and residential layouts, and the rain is the first thing we plan around. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 670 km away, and the machines come to you by road.

The Tunga runs through the city, and open spaces near the river and in the newer layouts suit an open air gym well. Our Fun Fitness machines need no electricity and no trainer, so a park committee can install them and leave them for public use. Our sales team can help you choose a starting set, and our installation team or a dealer in south India puts them in place, grouted or self-standing.

richText.heading: Machines and materials for a wet Malnad monsoon

c: From June to September the ground here stays wet for long stretches. Galvanised pipe frames and moulded plastic parts are the right base for that, but the footing matters as much. A raised concrete pad with a gentle slope stops water pooling under footplates, and a rubber-floored top gives better grip.

items.q: Is outdoor fitness equipment safe to leave out through the Shimoga monsoon?
items.a: Yes. The frames are galvanised and the seats and handles are roto-moulded, so they handle long wet spells. Keep the base drained and check moving parts after the rains.
No power supply is needed. Every Fun Fitness machine runs on the user's own body weight and movement, which keeps running costs very low for a park or college.

items.q: Can we start with a few machines and add more later?
items.a: Yes. Each station stands on its own base. Many buyers begin with three or four and add more once they see how the space is used.
